newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - Evening Standard - May 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Evening Standard - May 14.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
Tony Blair is facing a confrontation with the House of Lords over his plans to introduce a bill for a total ban on handguns.
BT-MCI MERGER GETS THE EURO GREEN LIGHT

The 12 billion stg merger between BT and MCI has received the approval of the European Commission, with only relatively minor conditions. The two companies now only require clearance from the US Department of Justice and the Federal Communications Commission in order to create the second largest telecommunications group in the world, after NTT of Japan.

Non-executive directors are increasingly used by public companies to fill important boardroom roles, according to a survey out today from the Institute of Chartered Accountants and headhunter PRO NED.
YEN STILL ON THE RISE AGAINST DOLLAR
The yen continued to rise against the dollar, following reassurances from Japan's Sumitomo Trust bank about its financial health.
